items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...like Johnny Carson has a band... INTERVIEWEE: No, this band -- this had no -- like Johnny's a whole show.

ctx.x: Yes, yes, that was a variety show. But they had a different artist every week to emcee the show, like Douglas Fairbanks, Jr. He would emcee the show one week. Bing Crosby, he would emcee the show. Then -- oh, I can't -- just so many people emceed the show. Then he would let me play every now and then, you know. And it was at the old Hollywood Palace show up here, where they had blackouts years ago, the El Capitan Theater, they called it the Hollywood Palace Theater. For three years, I did that. They had a…
Was this sort of the beginning of the -- you know, the kind of thing where -- like Johnny Carson has a band, which you hardly hear at all?

No, this band -- this had no -- like Johnny's a whole show. This was a variety show, like whoever would emcee the show -- we had acts, we had singers, we had -- they had chorus girls. They had a chorus girl for -- about 16 chorus girls and 8 chorus boys.
